name: io.github.phalkmin/trendzeist-mcp
title: Trendzeist – Google Trends for content ideation
description: Keyless MCP for content ideation and AEO: Google Trends, News, Wikipedia and citable-answer briefs.

environmentVariables.name: TRENDZEIST_HL
environmentVariables.description: Pin the Google Trends and Autocomplete language, e.g. en-US or pt-BR. When unset, language follows geo.

environmentVariables.name: TRENDZEIST_MIN_INTERVAL
environmentVariables.description: Minimum seconds between requests to Google (rate-limit protection).

environmentVariables.name: TRENDZEIST_COOLDOWN
environmentVariables.description: Seconds a source refuses uncached requests after an HTTP 429 (fail fast with retry_after; a Retry-After header wins when seen; 0 disables).

environmentVariables.name: TRENDZEIST_WIKI_MIN_INTERVAL
environmentVariables.description: Minimum seconds between requests to Wikimedia (separate lane from Google).

environmentVariables.name: TRENDZEIST_PROXIES
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated proxy URLs for rotation.

environmentVariables.name: TRENDZEIST_ARCHIVE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to disable the local observation archive behind what_changed / trend_history / recurring_topics.

environmentVariables.name: TRENDZEIST_ARCHIVE_DAYS
environmentVariables.description: Retention in days for observation archive rows.
